stem.text: The diagram shows an eyepiece graticule and a cell viewed through a microscope. When the eyepiece graticule was calibrated at this magnification, the whole length of the graticule shown covered 12 divisions of a stage micrometer scale.
There were 100 divisions in 10 mm of the stage micrometer.
